profiles.heading-aware: Markdown sections kept intact when possible; heading repeated when a section splits.
profiles.parent-child: Smaller child text is indexed; the containing section is returned as citation context.
profiles.docling-hybrid: Docling document hierarchy with BGE-tokenizer-aware splitting, heading context, and peer merging.

adoption_gate: Promote only when held-out retrieval quality improves for a relevant category without unacceptable index, latency, or implementation cost.
notes: All profiles use the same extraction output and frozen evaluation cases.
Sparse and hybrid retrieval are run separately; the profile is recorded in each output artifact.
Parent-child search results are deduplicated by returned parent context.
The controlled corpus includes multiple sections, distractors, Markdown tables, and multi-document questions.
